distinction_from_frozen_main_erica: This analysis does not replace data/erica_predeclared_visible_colour_developmental_gene_memory_design_v0_1.json. Its exact specimen/tip admission HOLD remains unchanged.
question: Among named Erica taxa with the same reported visible flower hue, is averaged molecular divergence across all published DNA vouchers associated with divergence in the 7-gene/3-age corolla expression profile?

operational_distance.phylogenetic_metric: For each pair of different named 2019 source taxa, average the original combined-tree patristic distances over the Cartesian product of all their frozen admissible 2025 DNA accession tip candidates (uniform source-tip weights). Never choose an accession based on expression.
operational_distance.branch_distance_units: molecular substitution-scale original IQTREE tree lengths, not millions of years, not a reconstruction of event occurrence
operational_distance.dependency: Taxon-name matched samples are not verified to be 2019 flower specimen or same population. Distance is an observational taxon-name-level proxy only.

expression.assay: original Fold Change (2^-delta-delta Ct) from source, PTB1_REF excluded
expression.unit: one source taxon, not stages/genes/technical replicates
expression.transform: log1p of nonnegative source fold change, then within 22 taxa z-score each of 21 fixed gene-by-stage features (population sd); fail closed on any missing or invariant column
expression.weights: Equal weight of all 21 stage-gene coordinates in RMS Euclidean pair distance, not pathway endpoint or selected flower stage
expression.primer_reference_caveat: Published common reference-gene normalization and conserved primer assays; batch/sample-specific calibration may still confound cross-taxon expression
expression.biological_interpretation_caveat: Taxon mean fold-change difference is not direct mutational regulatory identity and not fitness.

main_test.predictor: source-tip-uniform averaged tree patristic distance between 22 taxon labels
main_test.response: 21-feature RMS distance of log1p/z-scored fold changes
main_test.metric: Spearman rho across 83 within-colour unordered taxon pairs; pair distances are dependent observations, taxon is permutation unit
main_test.permutation: Within each of the four unchanged original visible-colour classes, shuffle entire 21-feature expression vectors among taxa (9,999 shuffles), keeping the averaged molecular tree distances fixed. This preserves gene-stage covariance.
main_test.decision: SUPPORTED_EXPLORATORY_TAXON_NAME_LEVEL only if observed>mean(permutation null) AND one-sided P<=0.05; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED_EXPLORATORY_TAXON_NAME_LEVEL. If exact source/complete panel fails, SOURCE_HOLD.
main_test.inferential_boundary: Retrospective exploratory taxon-name-level association, NOT preregistered independent prospective replication of the Petunieae exact-pigment-class estimand; no coevolution/selection or causal temporal decay.

secondary.nuclear_and_plastid: Recompute the same 83 taxon-pair source-tip mean distances from original nuclear and plastid 2025 trees, report raw Spearman rho only and compare sign descriptively. These are not independent radiation replications.
secondary.leave_one_taxon: All 22 deletion sensitivities on same analysis frame, no new P values, no threshold selection and no rescue using only positive groups.
secondary.voucher_choice_range: Use previously measured min/max molecular pair distances as a source-quality diagnostic, not a CI, not a new significance test.
